bounded_leaf_result.necessary_and_sufficient_result: A one-field CR14a construction exists if and only if there is an admissible replacement z in A different from identity(S.tail). Sufficiency: mutate only last_row_identity from b to z, which makes last_row_identity != identity(S.tail) and reaches boundary_link_mismatch; restoring b restores RESUME_OK. Necessity: with every other field fixed, CR14a can fail only if the mutated last_row_identity differs from b, so such a z must be admissible.
